items.md: Note: The red bubble signals an increase in mortality during 2011-21 while the green bubbles signal a decrease. The size of the bubbles is proportional to the mortality rate in 2021. 'Lung' includes cancers of the lung, trachea, and bronchus. ' Brain ' refers to both brain cancers and central nervous system cancers. The data correspond to the EU27 weighted averages.
items.value: Note: The red bubble signals an increase in mortality during 2011-21 while the green bubbles signal a decrease. The size of the bubbles is proportional to the mortality rate in 2021. 'Lung' includes cancers of the lung, trachea, and bronchus. ' Brain ' refers to both brain cancers and central nervous system cancers. The data correspond to the EU27 weighted averages.
